plugin.name: spread-overview
plugin._long: Spread every window across all workspaces and drag one to another workspace to relocate it.

option.name: drag_threshold
option._long: Pointer movement past which a press becomes a drag rather than a click.

option.name: spacing
option._long: Gap between thumbnails within a workspace cluster.

option.name: cluster_gap
option._long: Gap between workspace regions. 0 = edge-to-edge grid like expo.

option.name: small_window_boost
option._long: How much the shortest windows are enlarged relative to full-height ones before they are packed into rows. 1.0 packs every window at the same scale; 1.5 (the default) matches GNOME's overview; higher values make small windows more prominent at the cost of the large ones. Takes effect the next time the overview opens or reflows.

option.name: show_ws_labels
option._long: Draw the workspace number on each cluster. Off by default — the grid + dim veil already convey the workspaces.

option.name: include_minimized
option._long: Not yet functional in v1: minimized views have no displayed geometry, so their natural size for layout is unresolved. Parsed but has no effect until specified (see research.md R13).

option.name: background
option._long: Tint (RGB) and full-strength opacity (alpha) of the veil drawn over each workspace to dim it. The veil sits behind the window thumbnails, so windows stay crisp while their backdrops dim. The current workspace (and the drop target while dragging) is shown bright. Actual veil strength scales with inactive_brightness.

option.name: inactive_brightness
option._long: Brightness of every workspace except the active one (the current workspace, or the drop target while dragging). 1.0 = no dim; lower = darker. Veil alpha = background alpha * (1 - this). Mirrors expo's option of the same name.

option.name: border_size
option._long: Stroke width of the border drawn around each workspace region (the grid separating the workspaces).

option.name: border_color
option._long: Color of the grid border around each workspace region. Opaque by default so coincident gridlines at cluster_gap=0 do not compound alpha.

option.name: highlight_color
option._long: Color of the border drawn around the workspace a dragged window will drop into. Shown only while dragging, on the cell under the dragged thumbnail's center.

option.name: highlight_size
option._long: Stroke width of the drop-target highlight border (drawn while dragging a window over a workspace).

option.name: wallpaper_path
option._long: Absolute path to a PNG image drawn, scaled, into each workspace cell below the thumbnails (expo-style tiles). The plugin cannot read your wallpaper daemon's config, so point this at the same image file. Empty = disabled (cells show the existing full-screen wallpaper behind them). PNG only; a missing file or decode failure disables the feature without error.
